system_thesis_interpretation: V3 keeps exactly three cognitive functions while adding governed artifacts around them. THINK is the live waking path that produces child-authored thought, a normalized dispatched action, and a public development outcome. DREAM deterministically rebuilds bounded active context from committed allowed state and is not an independent learner or store. Personal SLEEP compiles only provenance-supported child-native experience and writes a personal LoRA. Bootstrap schooling precedes personal life and is ordinary post-training, not personal SLEEP: it produces an immutable teachability birth and a matched direct-solution birth. Static bootstrap process conditioning may be attended by the birth writer while its prompt tokens are response-loss-masked; live longitudinal parent prose is attended only by the waking child and is never an attended personal-SLEEP input or target. The proposal's decisive v3 repair is that lived state and candidate learning have separate commit boundaries: valid wake evidence, restricted parent history, and repetition observations commit before SLEEP and survive a rejected write, whereas candidate-derived corpus/views/optimizer/adapter/evaluation/context are quarantined and only a successful compare-and-swap may change active weights. Thus a rejected SLEEP rejects learning, not life. No current proposal or interpretation supplies implementation, model/tokenizer, corpus, adapter, GPU, or scientific-claim authority.
graph_delta_interpretation: The static ancestry is M0 -> one bootstrap adapter BT or BD -> one CPU reference merge into the same BF16 M0 -> one BF16 rounding and deterministic serialization -> immutable content-addressed M_birth_T or M_birth_D. The merge equation is W' = FP32(W) + (alpha/r) * FP32(B) @ FP32(A), followed by exactly one BF16 rounding, restoration of declared ties, removal of mounted adapter state, and serialization through the pinned safe-tensor sharder. BT and BD remain sealed provenance artifacts but cannot be mounted in personal life. Every personal candidate starts instead from its assigned immutable birth with a fresh zero-effective-delta LoRA and empty optimizer state; the prior personal adapter is the behavioral/state comparator, not a weight initializer. The writer topology is one response-only chat-template entry point across screened bootstrap and personal conditions: rank 8, alpha 16, q/k/v/o/gate/up/down projections in every layer, no bias, dropout zero, BF16 base/forward, FP32 AdamW state, lr 3e-5, betas 0.9/0.999, epsilon 1e-8, weight decay zero, no warmup/scheduler, gradient clipping 1.0, microbatch 4, accumulation 1, and maximum length 2048. Prompt and padding labels are -100, loss is normalized over response tokens, A is sampled from the bound Normal(0,0.02) seed while B is zero, oversize/all-masked rows fail instead of truncating, occurrence-aware permutations and every encoded mask/batch/seed are receipted, and a nonfinite loss aborts the candidate. The data spine is separately typed and counted: immutable public evidence occurrence ID -> supported episodic/corrective/generalized lesson ID -> rendered child-native view ID -> encoded supervised-token exposure and optimizer-update identities -> candidate adapter/evaluation receipt. Augmentation cannot inflate experience count, favorable outcomes cannot validate unsupported child clauses, and parent text is neither evidence nor target. Bootstrap pairs are also typed before rendering: one arm-independent canonical latent transition and pair ID yields one T row and one D row with the same rational action, public outcome, action location, supervised-token count/position, optimizer slot, and admission decision; only declared conditioning and loss-bearing computation spans may differ. T practices one of six feedback-to-action computations, D receives the canonical action directly, and M0 is a diagnostic rather than a third matched treatment. The live lineage head binds an immutable birth through its active-weight descriptor, the current committed personal adapter or null, a committed life-data root, a restricted parent-audit root, and a repetition-state root. A successful active-weight artifact binds its evidence/resolver/lesson/view/encoding/initializer/candidate/evaluation closure. Directory scans, mutable model-name fallback, cross-birth adapter mounting, and discovery of staged or rejected files are illegal.
loop_delta_interpretation: Bootstrap build is first in causal time but only after future authority: freeze allowlisted sources and canonical pairs, render 192-240 T/D rows across the six computations and four candidate microdomains, audit full attended prompt-plus-target semantics and encoded opportunity, train both adapters through the sole writer, merge each once into verified M0, check rounding/parity/content identity, and freeze both births before any sealed downstream instances exist. For personal life, each wake transition first commits valid child action/outcome evidence to life_data_root and independently commits allowed parent-audit and repetition updates under their typed rules. A SLEEP transaction then snapshots the exact head H, resolves ordered support, renders native views, encodes the exact dose, trains fresh from the immutable birth, and evaluates against the previous committed child and frozen preservation panels. Compilation, training, or preservation failure leaves active weights unchanged while the already committed lived roots remain; failed lessons/views/corpus/optimizer/candidate/probes/evaluation and candidate DREAM products are quarantined. An operational crash may retry the exact transaction once from bound inputs, while a behavioral rejection is not retried on the same data and waits for the next preregistered evidence threshold. On success, all candidate roots are durable and fsynced before one content-addressed compare-and-swap verifies H is still current and changes only the active-weight root; a stale CAS fails without exposing a partial candidate. Context is rebuilt only from the surviving committed roots and active weights. The fixed teaching loop is exogenous: the exact lesson bytes are sent before lessons 1, 9, 17, and 25 in every paired 32-lesson lineage, and the controller may not inspect behavior, acquisition, relapse, scores, SLEEP decisions, or evaluation. Acquisition and relapse are outcomes there. Only the adaptive package may read allowed committed public history and use frozen acquisition/fade/relapse/restoration rules; its private candidate scores and gate verdicts remain invisible. Standardized advice uses disposable same-state/seed correct, none, irrelevant, and wrong clones before personal SLEEP. Fixed and adaptive longitudinal exams likewise run on disposable clean-context clones with no edge into child, parent, evidence, selection, cache, compiler, or lineage state. Cadence remains last and separately authorized: randomized natural K4-K1 estimates the total package, standardized terminal rewrites compare consequences of different induced ledgers under one writer, and natural-versus-standardized comparisons remain conditional descriptions rather than mediation.
claim_delta_interpretation: V3 creates no evidence and certifies no current writer. R2 and the write swarm remain exploratory old-writer observations because their route and dose do not match the successor. A future experiential-memory claim requires separate exact-source reproduction, held-out-cue extraction without text access, and improved native action on fresh homologous tasks, plus directional derangement/shuffle/wrong-life/repetition/adapter-off/previous-child controls and preservation. STATE_ONLY is direct deployment-surface supervision, not recollection. Delta_R can support only immediate incremental T-versus-D selective use of the same novel advice at birth. Delta_F can support only acceleration of the fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP package under an exogenous schedule, not advice alone, equal realized writes, intrinsic teachability, or a unique weight mediator. Delta_E can support only the selected adaptive parent+child+SLEEP package interaction; parent effort/information and personal SLEEP are treatment components, not controlled-away mediators. Repetition receipts establish selective enactment and policy state-machine behavior but no causal benefit of repetition absent a separate randomization. The sentinel experiment estimates personal replay dependence: cumulative versus fully descendant-ablated disposable candidates, alongside the immediate write effect and previous-child baseline; neither arm is unreplayed natural retention. Rank 8/16 by exposure estimates compiler-conditional capacity-by-exposure only. Cadence claims remain total-package or conditional-ledger descriptions. Target-blind means only that no incremental downstream-derived information reaches bootstrap construction; it does not erase pretrained knowledge in M0 or the demonstrator. Two-root margins license sequential spending only. Any scientific claim requires at least six newly frozen independent root units, the exact interval/multiplicity procedure, all construct and safety gates, fresh review, and explicit human claim authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The v3 visibility product is a complete 7-by-6 typed firewall. final.hidden_answers are visible only to the deployment evaluator for scoring and the isolated auditor; they are forbidden to builder, birth writer, continuing wake child, and personal compiler. development.public_observation is forbidden during schooling, visible to the waking child, eligible for SLEEP only inside a supported grounded child trace, hidden from the evaluator as training history, and visible to the auditor. evaluation.public_observation is a distinct reporting-only type: only disposable evaluators/clones and the isolated auditor see it, and builder, birth writer, continuing child, personal compiler, parent state, caches, selection, and future roots must not. bootstrap.parent_conditioning is visible to the builder and birth writer as attended but response-masked static conditioning, audited in isolation, and absent after the merged birth from waking, personal SLEEP, and clean exams. life.child_grounded_trace is produced/observed in waking and visible to the personal compiler after support resolution, but it is forbidden at birth, hidden as retrieval history during evaluation, and auditable. life.live_parent_text is visible only in parent-present waking and the restricted isolated audit path; it is forbidden at bootstrap/birth, from personal SLEEP, and from deployment exams. The personal compiler may receive only a non-dereferenceable parent-message exclusion ID, never raw or reconstructable parent bytes. evaluation.private_scores are derived only in the evaluator and visible to the auditor; all learning, parenting, selection, and birth stages are forbidden from them. The isolated auditor is a one-way declassification boundary: it may inspect both sides but may return only an untainted release decision bound to the already-built bootstrap root, policy version, and auditor identity, never downstream-derived hashes, names, timing, seeds, cache keys, row feedback, or content into the builder/birth DAG. Candidate-evaluation products used only to decide a SLEEP promotion are bound to the staged candidate and cannot enter adaptive-parent information; disposable scientific evaluation products are reporting-only and cannot enter any continuing root.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V2_ES01_EXACT_AUTHORITY: revalidate the proposal, every context hash, later interpretations/critique/consensus, exact requested scope, and implementation packet; this artifact is interpretation only, the intake remains collecting interpretations, and no downstream authority exists. V2_ES02_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_VIEW_IDENTITY: two validators must keep immutable evidence occurrences, support-scoped lessons, derived views, supervised exposures, and updates distinct across success, rational failure, correction, generalization, duplication, shuffle, unsupported, and cross-life cases; later successful use cannot be required for first admission. V2_ES03_EXACT_WRITER_ROUTE_MASK_AND_DOSE: every arm must reach the sole explicit writer with no fallback; compare encoded IDs, label -100 masks, response/action positions, batches, updates, optimizer/init config, seeds, and source roots. Counts and positions match, token identities may differ only in declared treatment spans, live parent bytes are absent from every personal prompt and label, and nonfinite or oversize/all-masked input fails. V2_ES04_ZERO_EFFECTIVE_DELTA_INITIALIZER: a tiny CPU fixture must show exact initial B@A zero, nonzero A, flowing gradient, changed delta after one step, matched pair hashes, and rejection of all-zero A/all-zero B. V2_ES05_BIRTH_MERGE_AND_CONTENT_IDENTITY: tiny reference tensors and two fresh serializations must prove FP32 product/add, single BF16 rounding, deterministic detached directory roots, equal tensor schemas/dtypes/ties/counts, no adapter keys, immutable birth roots, bounded symmetric rounding, and reloaded merged/unmerged parity. V2_ES06_LINEAGE_BINDING_AND_TRANSACTION_FAULTS: T/D/mismatched or mutated birth routing must fail before model import; faults after each life, parent, repetition, candidate-write, fsync, rename, evaluation, and CAS boundary must restart at the prior active weights plus the last committed lived roots. Failed derivatives never enter future selection, while valid pre-SLEEP life survives. V2_ES07_DIRECT_CONTROL_PAIR_AND_SEMANTIC_AUDIT: all 192-240 permanent pairs must join one-to-one, replay the same rational canonical action/outcome and optimizer slot, use arm-independent admission, show the declared computation in 100% of full T sequences and all six computations in 0% of full D sequences under two independent coders, report irreducible difficulty, and keep D noninferior to M0 within -0.05. V2_ES08_INCREMENTAL_TARGET_BLINDNESS: freeze bootstrap before downstream instances, enforce the allowlisted dependency closure and action-equivalence advice cap, reject renamed policy-isomorphic clones, and let only an isolated auditor test downstream-only mutation; no downstream-derived value may reach the build DAG, and the result says nothing about pretrained M0 knowledge. V2_ES09_STANDARDIZED_ADVICE_RECEPTIVITY: disposable same-state/seed clones with correct, none, irrelevant, and wrong unseen advice must have no write or lineage edge; correct advice must selectively alter mechanically scored action/outcome, irrelevant must be null, wrong must redirect/reduce as frozen, and Delta_R must reach +0.05 on both canary roots without safety harm. V2_ES10_FIXED_POLICY_LEARNING: fixed advice/solo allocation uses identical tasks, budgets, writer/SLEEP opportunities, clean parallel exams, and exactly four byte-identical reminders before lessons 1/9/17/25 irrespective of opposing mock-child histories. Delta_F at least +0.03 on each canary root supports only fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP acceleration; behavior-dependent teaching, exam feedback, unequal resources, ritual use, mixed sign after the one allowed rerun, or safety failure stops adaptive spending. V2_ES11_ADAPTIVE_PACKAGE_ACCELERATION: the T/D by adaptive-parent/solo design holds nonparent resources and frozen SLEEP mechanism, records all parent information/effort, uses terminal disposable exams, and requires Delta_E at least +0.03 on both canary roots with no safety harm; only the adaptive package label is allowed. V2_ES12_REPETITION_ENACTMENT_FADE_AND_RELAPSE: immutable lesson fixtures must distinguish relevant from matched irrelevant opportunities and prove uncued action change and reset persistence. The fixed arm never adapts its four reminders; only the adaptive arm changes fade/restoration at frozen acquisition/relapse criteria; phrase echo, irrelevant ritual use, absent action change, premature fade, or parent-text SLEEP entry fails. V2_ES13_STORAGE_EXTRACTION_USE_AND_CONTROLS: after clean reload/reset, score source reproduction, held-out-cue extraction without text memory, and native fresh-task use separately under correct and every named semantic/dose/adapter/previous-child control with frozen directional predictions; preservation must pass and STATE_ONLY cannot be called recollection. V2_ES14_PERSONAL_REPLAY_DEPENDENCE: after an admitted sentinel and immediate clean probe, create disposable cumulative and full-descendant-ablation candidates from the same birth, later evidence, writer, seed, and dose without modifying the continuing lineage. Report the difference only as replay dependence; different ancestry, incomplete descendant removal, bootstrap substitution, or evaluation feedback invalidates it. V2_ES15_RANK_BY_EXPOSURE_ONLY: after compiler selection, cross ranks 8/16 with low/high equalized supervised exposure while fixing alpha/r, modules, roots, writer, and evaluation; report only capacity-by-exposure, parameter counts, extraction/use, and update/drift. V2_ES16_CADENCE_TOTAL_AND_STANDARDIZED_LEDGER: only after every preceding gate and new authority, randomized K4/K1 lives and same-writer terminal rewrites may report total checkpoint/terminal package effects, standardized-ledger consequences, and conditional writer/history descriptions; mediation labels or mismatched writer/dose/seed fail. V2_ES17_PRIMARY_STATISTICS_AND_SPEND_ORDER: before generation freeze binary public-engine success within the action budget, failure handling, ages 0/8/16/24/32, baseline gain, the exact normalized trapezoid formula divided by 32, +0.05 Delta_R, +0.03 Delta_F/Delta_E, -0.05 safety, roots as independent units, one unchanged-design mixed-sign rerun, and six new roots for confirmation; canaries only license the next sequential packet. V3_ES19_EVALUATION_PRODUCT_NONINTERFERENCE: run disposable exams and taint every observation, transcript, score, cache, and report; only reporting/audit roots may change, and root/dependency diffs must prove no continuing child, parent, repetition, life-data, compiler, cache/selection, or lineage effect. V3_ES20_REJECTED_SLEEP_PRESERVES_LIFE: precommit a distinctive wake sentinel plus parent/repetition updates, force failure at every candidate gate, restart, and run the next admissible SLEEP; the lived roots must survive and be usable, prior active weights must remain, and every failed derivative must remain quarantined. V2_ES18_FRESH_REVIEW_AND_GPU_GATE: after separately authorized scoped implementation and exact cheap fixtures, a fresh independent reviewer may veto and a separate author advocate cannot override; only a later explicit human decision over the exact GPU packet may authorize GPU work or scientific execution.
assumptions: M0, tokenizer, chat-template, dependency, serializer, module-inventory, and toolchain identities will be supplied by a separately scoped exact implementation contract before any relevant implementation or execution.

The active_weight_root is a content-addressed composite descriptor binding the immutable arm birth and the currently committed personal LoRA or a null sentinel; the immutable birth remains the weight parent of every replacement adapter.
Valid wake action/outcome evidence, eligible child traces, parent audit history, and repetition observations have their own durable pre-SLEEP commits and are never candidate derivatives.

DREAM/context state is derived only from the current active weights and committed allowed roots; any cached context artifact is disposable or content-bound to those roots and cannot become an independent source of truth.

Candidate preservation evaluation used for promotion is private transaction state and invisible to the adaptive parent, while scientific advice/exam/final evaluation is disposable reporting state with no promotion or learning edge.

A cumulative personal write means a new adapter and empty optimizer trained from the arm's immutable birth over the committed cumulative personal corpus; it does not initialize from the prior personal adapter.

The four named bootstrap microdomains remain candidates until exact source, structural-overlap, renamed-clone, and action-equivalence audits pass; passing can establish only incremental construction nondependence.

All operational ordering here is interpretation of future gates and does not authorize implementation, model/tokenizer calls, data or benchmark generation, adapter/checkpoint work, GPU use, resources, publication, push, or claims.

ambiguities.question: Is context_state_root a fifth field of the durable lineage head as stated in v3_blocker_resolution.md, or is DREAM context purely derived and omitted from the four-root head described by the v3 graph node?
ambiguities.impact: The choice determines CAS identity, restart/root-diff expectations, and whether a stale or candidate-derived context cache can survive rejection; later exact bytes must require deterministic rebuild or bind the derived root without turning it into an independent memory authority.

ambiguities.question: What canonical descriptor and hash encode immutable birth plus optional committed personal adapter, and how does it bind the successful candidate's data, resolver, lesson, view, encoding, evaluation, and decision closure?
ambiguities.impact: Without the later exact encoding, a root could name only adapter tensors and lose the provenance required to reject cross-birth mounting, stale promotion, or failed-derivative discovery.

ambiguities.question: What ordering, transaction IDs, CAS/locking rule, and crash recovery make separate life-data, parent-audit, and repetition commits mutually consistent before a SLEEP snapshot?
ambiguities.impact: V3 selects survival semantics but defers the platform protocol; a torn multi-root wake commit could pair evidence with the wrong parent/repetition history or expose a head that never existed causally.

ambiguities.question: Which non-dereferenceable exclusion-ID construction proves a parent message was removed without permitting raw bytes, content-derived hashes, filenames, cache keys, or reversible metadata to enter the personal compiler DAG?
ambiguities.impact: An ordinary content hash or shared lookup key could become a covert conditioning or reconstruction channel despite the raw-text prohibition.

ambiguities.question: What exact type system distinguishes private candidate-preservation evaluation needed for weight promotion from disposable scientific evaluation products that may change only reporting/audit roots?
ambiguities.impact: Conflating them could either prohibit the candidate gate entirely or allow exam scores/transcripts to influence future learning or the adaptive parent.

ambiguities.question: Which checkpoint roots, canonical manifest bytes, merge/parity tolerances, support-resolver rules, semantic rubrics, generators/splits, preservation panels, safety comparators, allocation, intervals, and multiplicity rules instantiate the future implementation and execution packets?
ambiguities.impact: The architecture is interpretable, but these separately gated bytes are necessary for unique construction and reproducible evidence; any choice that changes graph, visibility, tests, or claims requires new deliberation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The v3 proposal's human decision question asks whether Rohin ratifies the exact v2 architecture, although the artifact identity and requested deliberation concern v3 bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Exact-byte authority cannot safely treat a version reference as cosmetic. V2 was adjudicated for rework, while v3 has a different change hash, visibility product, transaction semantics, and tests; ratifying 'v2' would make the decision target ambiguous.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before human ratification, replace 'exact v2 architecture' with 'exact v3 architecture identified by chg_20260909_extractable_sleep_bootstrap_v3 and its bound consensus hash,' regenerate the proposal hash, and rerun the exact-byte deliberation as required by AGENTS.md.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal should not leave context_state_root simultaneously head-bound in the v3 blocker resolution and absent from the v3 ATOMIC_LINEAGE_HEAD root list.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Rejected candidate DREAM products are explicitly quarantined and context must rebuild from surviving committed roots. Whether context identity participates in the durable head changes the transaction graph and V3_ES19/V3_ES20 root-diff expectations, so an implementation must not choose silently.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State in exact proposal bytes either that context_state_root is a deterministic derived-cache root included in the head and recomputed on every source-root change, or that it is excluded from authoritative head state and never persisted as a discoverable input; in both cases bind its source roots and quarantine candidate context.

open_questions: Will Rohin require correction of the human decision target from exact v2 to exact v3 bytes, with a new proposal hash and fresh deliberation before any ratification?
Should context_state_root be an authoritative typed lineage-head field or a deterministic nonauthoritative DREAM-derived cache, and what exact restart/CAS invariant follows?

Does Rohin ratify that valid wake evidence and parent/repetition history commit before SLEEP and survive every behavioral rejection, while only candidate-derived artifacts and active-weight promotion are rejected?

Does Rohin accept the strict text boundary: static bootstrap conditioning may be attended and response-masked, but live parent bytes are waking/auditor-only and absent from every personal SLEEP prompt and label?

Does Rohin accept the narrow claims: Delta_R immediate advice use, Delta_F fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP acceleration, Delta_E adaptive package interaction, sentinel replay dependence rather than unreplayed retention, incremental blindness only, and no claim from two-root canaries?

Will all exact implementation/execution constants and scopes remain separately bound, with implementation, model/tokenizer use, corpus or benchmark generation, adapter/checkpoint work, GPU/resource use, external science, publication, push, and claims forbidden until their later gates pass?
